Core harvest/structure paths are tested and the general Ultimate gap is closed by the default-branch gate. The remaining named gap is the source greenhouse matrix surface: upstream GreenhouseBE and LargeGreenhouseBE implement GreenhouseMatrixMember, and JDTE ships GreenhouseMatrixRuntime/ICreativeGreenhouse so a separate controller mod (jdte_matrix) can claim a greenhouse, drive its production profile and recognise a creative greenhouse that lives in that other mod. No counterpart exists for 1.20.1 — this repository contains no reference to it and no published 1.20.1 build was found — so porting the surface here would be dead code with no consumer. The row therefore stays **P** with a precise, non-actionable gap: the integration is missing because its only consumer is absent. Revisit only if a 1.20.1 controller mod appears.

Verified 2026-11-02 on muse/forge-1.20.1-sender-validation: Ultimate cards verified by GameTest (ItemSenderUltimateGameTests, 11 tests) plus remaining-function GameTests (ItemSenderValidationGameTests, 9 tests): both Ultimate cards install with speed exclusivity, Ultimate Capacity gives Advanced 2500000 / Extended 5000000 FE (20000000 / 40000000 with 3 Capacity cards) and no measurable effect on Basic, Ultimate Overclock runs 10 ticker executions with the original base 64-per-execution normal cap (640/tick theoretical, stock-limited to 576), standard cost 25000 with direct-path deduction per moving execution and normal-path FE gate without per-operation deduction, redstone HIGH/LOW modes, Creative card (full 576 stock, zero FE), Underclock (one 64 batch per 40 ticks), area persistence and reach, Range scaling, refill throughput distinguishing 576 stock from 640/20000/100000 theoretical caps, and a SURVIVAL FakePlayer break of a non-default sender dropping exactly one self item per tier. Real Xvfb client opened all three GUIs (4/4/8 upgrade slots, 9 machine slots), GUI shift-click installed both Ultimate cards on Basic, creative tab and JEI contain all three senders and both Ultimate cards, baked models present. The other 27 Ultimate-restricted families are unchanged.
